(Legacy) Partial marketplace product sync

API for selectively updating specified fields of mall products matched to Shoplinker.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/MallSendStock.php?iteminfo_url=XML URL[URL-encoded]&type=type value
  • type : 001 - By mall product code -> send mall products individually - 1:1
  • type : 002 - By own-store product code -> send mall products in bulk - 1:N
  • type : 003 - By own-store product code -> send marketplace products in bulk - 1:N -> update the original Shoplinker product

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. mall_product_id string Marketplace product code When type is 001 Required input value.
3. mall_id string Shoplinker marketplace code When type is 001 Required input value.
4. partner_product_id string Customer product code (product management code) When type is 002 or 003 Required input value.
5. sale_status string Sale status Allowed values
  1. - On sale : 001
  2. - Sales suspended : 003
  3. - Sold out : 004
  4. - Delete : 005
  5. - Sales ended : 006
6. market_price integer Marketplace list price
7. sale_price integer Marketplace sale price
8. supply_price integer Marketplace supply price
9. quantity integer Product quantity
10. stock_gubun string Required option type Allowed values
  1. - Update by code: 001
  2. - Modify after reset : 002
 - When updating optionsRequired input value.
- When updating by code: only quantity and price are applied
- After reset: delete all options before applying changes
11. add_stock_gubun string Additional option type Allowed values
  1. - Update by code: 001
  2. - Modify after reset : 002
 - When updating optionsRequired input value.
- When updating by code: only quantity and price are applied
- After reset: delete all options before applying changes
stock_row string Repeated row tag for required options - When updating required options Required input value.
12. stock_name string Option title - When updating required optionsRequired input value.
Separate combined options with /. Example: Color/Size
13. stock_value string Option value - When updating required optionsRequired input value.
Separate combined option values with /. Example: Black/95
14. stock_quantity integer Option quantity - When updating required options Required input value.
15. stock_sale_price integer Option additional price
16. stock_supply_price integer Option supply price
17. stock_keyword string Option keywords
18. stock_partner_code string Option management code
19. stock_barcode string Option barcode
20. stock_supplier string Option supplier
21. stock_supplier integer Option safety stock
add_stock_row string Repeated row tag for additional options - When modifying additional options Required input value.
22. add_stock_name string Additional option title - When modifying additional options Required input value.
23. add_stock_value string Additional option value - When modifying additional options Required input value.
24. add_stock_quantity integer Additional option quantity - When modifying additional options Required input value.
25. add_stock_sale_price integer Additional option surcharge
26. add_stock_supply_price integer Additional option supply price
27. add_stock_keyword string Additional option keyword
28. add_stock_partner_code string Additional option management code
29. add_stock_barcode string Additional option barcode
30. add_stock_supplier string Additional option supplier
31. add_stock_supplier integer Additional option safety stock
32. ImageLink string Image update Allowed values
  1. - Disabled : NULL
  2. - Enabled : Y
Send the original product images to the marketplace (Auction, Gmarket and 11st only)

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  1. - Success : true
  2. - Failure : false
2. product_id string Marketplace product code
3. message string Result message Success or failure message 
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="euc-kr" ?>
<Shoplinker>;
	<ResultMessage>
		<result>true</result>
		<product_id>P012545</product_id>
		<message>수정성공</message>
	</ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
